title: Winged Angel in Ruins
description: A humanoid figure with large blue and gold feathered wings stands in the center of ancient stone ruins. The character has a split black and white face with horns, a glowing halo, and wears a long coat over a vest and dark skirt, with one leg covered in ornate golden patterns.
prompt: A majestic humanoid figure with massive blue and gold feathered wings stands in ancient crumbling stone ruins under a bright sky. The character has a split black and white face with curved horns, a glowing halo above its head, and wears a long open coat with a red vest, white shirt, and dark skirt. One bare leg features intricate golden patterns. Dramatic lighting with rays emanating from the figure, dusty atmosphere, cinematic fantasy style.
